name: GitHub, Actions
description: Most recent CI runs across watched repos. Each workflow row pairs its conclusion icon + a workflow-type glyph (build / test / deploy / lint / docs / release / security / ci) with a mini timeline of the last 8 runs (bar height ∝ duration, colour ∝ conclusion) and the latest run's duration. With no repos listed, it scans the account's most recently pushed repos (capped by Max repos to scan). Public repos work without a token; private repos require the PAT in Plugins → GitHub Core.

cell_options.name: account
cell_options.label: Account
cell_options.help: Connected GitHub App or account from GitHub Core. Blank uses the default account, or public access if none is connected.

cell_options.name: repos
cell_options.label: Repos
cell_options.help: One per line, as owner/repo. Leave blank to scan the account's most recently pushed repos.

cell_options.name: max_repos
cell_options.label: Max repos to scan
cell_options.help: Only used when Repos is blank: how many of the most recently pushed repos to check (1-30). Each repo costs one API call per refresh.
